resources.string: Each rib meets the thoracic spine at its back end. The pale rear arcs show where the ribs turn toward the spine.
The long bony shaft curves around the side of the chest, with a space between it and the neighboring ribs.
Each of the first seven rib pairs reaches the sternum through its own cartilage. The cartilage bridges bone to bone at the front.
Cartilages of ribs 8 to 10 typically join the cartilage above instead of reaching the sternum separately, forming the sloping costal margin.
Ribs 11 and 12 attach at the back but do not join the sternum or the costal arch at their free front ends.
